title: Pineland Road Wildfire Smoke/Fire Candidate Replay
description: Source-backed Sentinel Hub close look for the April-May 2026 Pineland Road Fire in Clinch/Echols Counties, Georgia.
task_text: Review the Pineland Road wildfire northwest of Fargo, Georgia for active-fire, smoke, burn-scar, fireline, road corridor, and civilian lifeline context. Keep claims candidate-only unless source-backed bands, SCL/cloud metadata, burn indices, or hotspot context support them.
summary: A real Sentinel-2 L2A SWIR/NIR/Red replay seeded from Sentinel Hub. The active fire/smoke frame is intentionally kept as review-only because Sentinel SCL flags white smoke/cloud ambiguity.

alerts.timelapse_analysis: The replay compares a March-April baseline, an April 16 ignition/pre-active window, and the April 20 active fire window. The active frame shows strong SWIR/NIR/Red wildfire candidate context, but the confidence-assist layer defers a smoke claim because SCL cloud support is 100 percent.
alerts.analysis_summary: This is a repeatable real-data wildfire proof case: the app can retain the smoky active frame, surface the ambiguity, and avoid overclaiming from RGB-like appearance alone.
alerts.satellite_note: Orbital triage retained the Pineland Road active-window frame as a smoke/cloud review candidate.
alerts.ground_note: Ground review should inspect the seeded frame and keep the claim candidate-only unless hotspot or burn-context support is added.
alerts.ground_action: REVIEW - active wildfire candidate packet is downlink-ready, but SCL cloud support requires human review.
findings: The active frame is real Sentinel-2 L2A data cached from Sentinel Hub
The active window was retained because dataMask was valid even though SCL treated the plume as cloud
The postfire window was rejected because cloud/valid-pixel quality did not pass the seed gate
